newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close touch lower on U.S., Ericsson.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close touch lower on U.S., Ericsson.

text.p: Swedish shares ended slightly lower on Monday, depressed by the U.S. opening lower and by a fall in giant telecommunications group Ericsson.
But indices were supported by strong gains for drugs company Astra and the forestry sector.
The Stockholm general index slipped 0.05 percent to 2284.07 after turnover of 3.0 billion crowns.
Ericsson slid 1.5 crowns to 205.5 crowns, despite getting a 1.4 billion crown mobile telephone order in Japan.
Astra was boosted by approval for a wider use of anti-ulcer agent Losec from the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
Astra leapt four crowns on the news to 326 crowns.
As the market closed, Astra said that the approval was not likely to speed up the agent's sales growth rate.
Analysts found the continued rally in forestry shares hard to explain and said the sector is mainly catching up as no new fundamentals have appeared. The sector rose 1.55 percent.
Stora rose 1.5 crowns to 93.50 while MoDo edged up 1.5 to 185 crowns. AssiDoman climbed four to 177 crowns.
